activities.target_text: How much is this? It costs thirty rupees.

activities.target_text: That is too expensive. Can I have it for forty rupees?
activities.hindi_scaffold: दुकानदार ने ज़्यादा दाम बताया — मोल-भाव करें — English में बोलिए।
